title: Why do your muscles twitch at night? ⚡
caption:
Small twitches under the skin are usually harmless: tired muscles, caffeine, stress and poor sleep make them more likely. Twitching with weakness or shrinking muscles is different: see a doctor. Do yours twitch after training? 👇

General information, not medical advice.
